worldcombat.skill.barrier.summary: Pick a spot and raise a hard-light wall there, perpendicular to the cast direction, while raising Defense. This Defense increase ends when the wall disappears.
worldcombat.skill.barrier.use.0: Raise the wall yourself across the lane an opponent charges down
worldcombat.skill.barrier.use.1: Place the wall across a side path instead of being forced toward the nearest enemy
worldcombat.skill.barrier.use.2: Raise it tall to cut off a ranged firing line
worldcombat.skill.barrier.description.0: While the wall stands, Defense is raised by %1$s level(s) for about %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.barrier.description.1: The wall is %1$s blocks wide and %2$s blocks tall; the chosen point is the wall centre and its face is perpendicular to the cast direction. Casing it in place drops it %3$s blocks ahead.
worldcombat.skill.barrier.tall.on: Tall screen: a taller, narrower wall set farther out, standing higher than the bulwark and blocking more fire from high ground or over the top, and it goes up faster; it is narrow enough to walk around and shields for less time.
worldcombat.skill.barrier.tall.off: Bulwark: a wider, lower wall set close that stops a frontal charge and shields longer; it stands lower, so fire from high ground or over the top slips past more easily, and it takes longer to raise.
worldcombat.skill.barrier.timing: Aimed-point move, range %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, recovers for %3$s s and starts a %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.barrier.growth.0: At level %1$s the wall lasts %2$s and the cooldown shortens to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.barrier.growth.1: At level %1$s the wall lasts %2$s and the cooldown shortens to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.barrier.preference.tal: On: a taller, narrower wall set farther out, standing higher than the bulwark, blocking more fire from high ground or over the top and going up faster, but narrow enough to walk around and shielding for less time. Off: a wide low bulwark that stops a frontal charge and shields longer, but stands lower and is slower to raise.
Consider raising a wall when a threat enters this range. Higher values prepare sooner.
Do not raise the wall when a threat is closer than this distance; respond to the close attack instead.
Lead a moving threat by this many ticks and lay the wall across its incoming path; 0 uses only its current direction.
worldcombat.skill.barrier.description.pl: Pick a point up to %1$s blocks away; the wall only forms in air cells and leaves a gap for any occupied or solid spot, so a spot with no free cells makes no wall and shows no complete barrier.
